subject: Re: connection issue
text: Thanks for your note. I saw the earlier thread. We have a small issue. You said it was likely the router. I think otherwise. My tests disagree a little. The connection dropped twice. Then it returned. I checked the local port. It responds oddly. The log shows a timeout. That worries me. The server is not rejecting the key. That part is clear. But the handshake stops halfway. I suspect a configuration mismatch. You mentioned a firewall rule. It may still be active. I cannot see your side. I do not want to guess. Could you send the latest logs? Please include timestamps. I can compare them quickly. I also need the session ID. It should be easy to find. Please do not reboot first. I want the state preserved. The client app matters too. We can try a clean start later. I know deadlines are tight. This feels bigger than a glitch. My estimate may change slightly. I understand if you worry. Please share the requested files. Then we can decide. I will wait. Thanks for your patience. The problem is solvable. We just need proof. My screen looks different from yours. That is normal. We should not panic. Let us work from data. Please send what you can. I will reply fast. Once I have it, I will isolate the cause. Maybe it is a setting. Maybe it is the app version. Maybe it is both. If the logs match, we can fix it quickly. If not, we will need longer. I can do either. Your help will make this quick. I appreciate you bearing with me. We will get it steady.
